request: why do a triangle's angles always add up to 180 degrees?

beats.intent: A triangle with its three angles coloured, lifted off and laid on a straight line
beats.narration: Tear off the three corners of any triangle and lay them side by side: they fill a straight line.

beats.intent: The straight line of angles beside a + b + c = 180°
beats.narration: A straight line is a half turn, so the three angles add to one hundred and eighty degrees.

beats.intent: A four-sided shape split by a diagonal into two triangles
beats.narration: Any four-sided shape splits into two triangles along a diagonal.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
quad = draw_polygon(stage, [(-2.5, -1.6), (2.5, -1.3), (1.8, 1.4), (-1.6, 1.1)])
diag = draw_line(stage, (-2.5, -1.6), (1.8, 1.4), color=YELLOW, dashed=True)

beats.narration: Two triangles' worth of angles: three hundred and sixty degrees.

request: how can you measure a tree's height from its shadow?

beats.intent: A 1 m stick with its 1.5 m shadow drawn as a right triangle
beats.narration: A one metre stick casts a shadow one and a half metres long.
beats.code:
stage.title("Height from a shadow")
stick = draw_line(stage, (-5, -2), (-5, -0.8), color=ORANGE)
shade1 = draw_line(stage, (-5, -2), (-3.2, -2), color=GREY_B)
ray1 = draw_line(stage, (-5, -0.8), (-3.2, -2), color=YELLOW, dashed=True)
stage.label(stick, "1 m", direction=LEFT, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(shade1, "1.5 m", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A tree with a 12 m shadow and the same sun angle
beats.narration: At the same moment, the tree's shadow is twelve metres. The sun's rays come in at the same angle.
beats.code:
tree = draw_line(stage, (-1, -2), (-1, 1.2), color=GREEN)
crown = draw_circle(stage, radius=0.5, color=GREEN, fill=0.6)
crown.move_to([-1, 1.5, 0])
shade2 = draw_line(stage, (-1, -2), (3.8, -2), color=GREY_B)
ray2 = draw_line(stage, (-1, 1.2), (3.8, -2), color=YELLOW, dashed=True)
stage.label(shade2, "12 m", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The two triangles beside h / 12 = 1 / 1.5, so h = 8 m
beats.narration: The triangles are the same shape, so height over shadow is the same: the tree is eight metres tall.
beats.code:
stage.label(tree, "h", direction=LEFT, color=GREEN)
stage.equation(r"\frac{h}{12} = \frac{1}{1.5}", r"\Rightarrow h = 8\ \text{m}")

request: how do you add a half and a third?

beats.intent: One bar with half shaded, another with a third shaded
beats.narration: Here is a half and here is a third. The pieces are different sizes, so we can't just add them.
beats.code:
stage.title("1/2 + 1/3")
half = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=3, height=0.8, color=WHITE) for _ in range(2)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([0, 1.4, 0])
half[0].set_fill(BLUE, opacity=0.7)
third = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=2, height=0.8, color=WHITE) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([0, 0.2, 0])
third[0].set_fill(ORANGE, opacity=0.7)
stage.play(Create(half), Create(third))
stage.add(half, third)
stage.label(half, r"\frac{1}{2}", direction=LEFT, color=BLUE)
stage.label(third, r"\frac{1}{3}", direction=LEFT, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: Both bars cut into sixths: 3 sixths blue, 2 sixths orange
beats.narration: Cut both into sixths. A half is three sixths; a third is two sixths.
beats.code:
cuts = VGroup(*[Line([-3 + k, 1.8, 0], [-3 + k, -0.2, 0], color=GREY_B, stroke_width=2) for k in range(1, 6)])
stage.play(Create(cuts))
stage.add(cuts)

beats.intent: A third bar of six sixths with 5 filled: 3 blue then 2 orange
beats.narration: Put them together: three sixths and two sixths make five sixths.
beats.code:
sixths = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=1, height=0.8, color=WHITE) for _ in range(6)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([0, -1.2, 0])
for k in range(3):
    sixths[k].set_fill(BLUE, opacity=0.7)
for k in range(3, 5):
    sixths[k].set_fill(ORANGE, opacity=0.7)
stage.play(Create(sixths))
stage.add(sixths)
stage.label(sixths, r"\frac{5}{6}", direction=LEFT, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: One half plus one third is five sixths.

request: what is the sine of an angle?

beats.intent: A radius turning on the unit circle with its height traced out as a wave
beats.narration: Turn a radius of length one around a circle. Its height, traced out, is the sine wave.
beats.code:
stage.title("Sine is a height")
c, ax, wave = circle_to_sine(stage)

beats.narration: At thirty degrees the height is one half. Straight up, at ninety degrees, it is one.

beats.intent: A 30-60-90 triangle with hypotenuse 1 and opposite side 1/2
beats.narration: In a right triangle with hypotenuse one, the side opposite a thirty degree angle is exactly one half.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
tri = draw_polygon(stage, [(-2, -1.5), (1.46, -1.5), (1.46, 0.5)], color=BLUE)
stage.label((-0.27, -0.5), "1", direction=UL, color=WHITE)
stage.label((1.46, -0.5), r"\frac{1}{2}", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
ang = Angle(Line([-2, -1.5, 0], [1.46, -1.5, 0]), Line([-2, -1.5, 0], [1.46, 0.5, 0]), radius=0.9, color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(ang))
stage.add(ang)
stage.label(ang, "30°", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)
stage.caption("sine = opposite ÷ hypotenuse")
